from.place: Finite-filtration convergence argument: upper-tail stationary cycles, as used in the canonical quotient comparison

title: FiniteCoconeLimitCycles
statement: For a type-zero bigraded exact couple [def-sp-exact-couple], any limiting subobjects L [def-sp-convergence], and a regular cycle tower, if on every total-degree diagonal the D terms vanish for all sufficiently large first indices, then L.Z(p,q) equals the image of the transported initial g at every integer bidegree (p,q).

proof.text: Use the uniquely prescribed image/inclusion families of pageCouple_image_prefix. Induct on r with projection_zero, projection_succ, cycleLift_comm and DerivedMaps.f_comm to identify projection_r followed by f_r and I_r with the cycle inclusion followed by initial f.

Choose r so the incoming r-fold alpha source at (p+2,q-1) lies beyond the zero bound on total degree p+q+1. The image identity and monicity force I_r=0. The preceding equation forces initial f to vanish on Z_r, hence on L.Z by its GLB property. Exactness, with type-zero transports, gives L.Z <= ker f = im initialG. The theorem g_factors_limitCycles gives the reverse inequality.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteCocone_limitCycles
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] [Abelian C]
    (X : BigradedExactCouple C 0) (L : X.LimitSubobjects) (hreg : X.IsRegular)
    (hzero : ∀ n : ℤ, ∃ b : ℤ, ∀ P : ℤ, b ≤ P → IsZero (X.D P (n - P)))
    (p q : ℤ) : L.Z p q = imageSubobject (X.initialG p q)
